title: Marsriva MR-LFP24-100-WMD 25.6V 102Ah BYD Cell LiFePO4 Battery

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The MR-LFP24-100-WMD LiFePO4 Battery is a powerful and reliable 24V energy storage solution designed for solar systems, inverters, UPS backup, telecom base stations, and residential or commercial energy storage. With 102Ah capacity and about 2.6kWh usable energy, this battery ensures a consistent and stable power supply during outages or peak demand.


Built with advanced LiFePO4 chemistry, it offers exceptional cycle life of over 6000 cycles, far exceeding the lifespan of traditional lead-acid batteries. The integrated Battery Management System (BMS) provides comprehensive protection, ensuring safe operation by monitoring temperature, voltage, and current levels.


This battery supports up to 15 units in parallel, making it ideal for scalable solar or backup power systems. Its compact, lightweight design supports both wall-mount and floor-standing installation, giving flexibility for homes, offices, small data centers, and industrial use.


With long service life, high energy efficiency, and superior safety, the MR-LFP24-100-WMD stands as a premium LiFePO4 solution for modern energy storage needs.


Key Features


  • 25.6V nominal output for stable inverter/solar performance
  • 102Ah capacity providing approx. 2.6kWh energy storage
  • Long lifecycle of 6000+ cycles at 25°C
  • Built-in BMS for protection from overcharge, over-discharge, short-circuit & overcurrent
  • Supports up to 15 batteries in parallel for extended capacity
  • High charge/discharge current capacity for demanding loads
  • Supports wall-mount and floor-mount installation
  • Maintenance-free, lightweight, and highly efficient LiFePO4 chemistry
  • Excellent thermal and chemical stability
